name: Vibescam
tagline: A founder vibe codes a product that does not exist on his launch stream: every step up the curve ships another AI-generated feature, badge and claim for $VIBE, a token with no tokenomics, no sell button and a padlock drawn open, while the chat, the holders and his sweat climb with the number. Cash out to sell before the rug, or stay for the sticker to peel off the SHIP IT button, the product to turn to vapor, and the founder to leave with the LP bag.
